courses.summary: 以印尼整合鎳礦處理為背景，分析紅土含水、熱需求、品位及復育。 五組案例問題依序建立控制體、重算數值、檢查量測與診斷失效；計算參數是公開原理下的合成教學基準，並非該礦實際產能、設計條件或操作設定。
courses.summaryEn: An integrated Indonesian nickel-processing setting examines laterite moisture, heat demand, grade and rehabilitation. Five case investigations define boundaries, recalculate quantities, check measurements and diagnose failures. Numerical inputs are synthetic teaching benchmarks based on public principles, not the mine’s actual capacity, design conditions or operating settings.
